name: Resultants of componentwise copies are copies
description: Corollary 4.59: componentwise copies lift to resultant copies. Both IsCopyOf directions are stated (cor4_59_resultant_copy and cor4_59_resultant_copy_symm / _both).

elements.text: When every component homomorphism is 1TO1, the product state map and the portwise input and output maps are 1TO1 as well.
Opposite IsCopyOf direction via Ex 4.84 symmetry under Nonempty free-port values.
